name: Seven-Day SOC-Adjusted Efficiency
Capture SOC and Start Measurement Cycle
Read README: same flow tab as batt_level writer; configure capacity and context stores
info: Configure the two daily kWh input sensors and the external SOC writer before importing. Use the same tab as flow.batt_level, memoryOnly and cached file context stores, and select your Home Assistant server. Fresh installations start from the first paired sample; no v2 import. Existing v3 state is retained. See round-trip-efficiency/README.md.
